ITEM 1 | Whole raw almonds, oval tan-brown with smooth, dry, matte skins and slight ridges, piled in a loose mound about 10 cm across and 1.5 to 2 cm deep, on the left side of the plate | 65
ITEM 2 | Cubed pale green-cream melon, pieces about 2 to 2.5 cm square with firm, slightly glossy cut faces and some translucent edges, scattered in a cluster on the right side of the plate, about 1.5 to 2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 3 | Small round green sprout-like heads, about 2.5 to 3.5 cm across, firm and compact with layered leaves, some with browned, blistered, or charred outer leaf edges and a few dark brown spots, about 9 pieces clustered in the lower-center of the plate | 150
